versions.changelog: Security fixes: credential scoping, TT3 host allowlist, removed unimplemented features, added permission declarations and privacy notice

Initial release of MENA Property Listing Generator

- Instantly creates bilingual (Arabic + English) property listings, social media posts, 10-slide Instagram carousels, TikTok scripts, Facebook content, 4-page PDF brochures, and WhatsApp scripts from 5–10 photos and property specs.
- Saves 2–4 hours per listing with SEO-optimized, culturally relevant MENA copywriting and RTL formatting.
- Supports bulk generation, reformatting for multiple platforms, and agent branding customization.
- Designed for top regional real estate platforms (PropertyFinder, Bayut, Dubizzle) and currencies (QAR, AED, SAR, EGP).
- Provides troubleshooting and common customization tips for local agents.
